emergencyIntro.title: Crypto in emergency situations
emergencyIntro.subtitle: Alternative systems when traditional ones don't work

origin.title: Why cryptocurrencies were born
origin.content: Cryptocurrencies were born after the 2008 crisis. In that context the problem was not the lack of money, but the impossibility of using it freely.

situations.title: In several countries situations occurred such as:

origin.conclusion: The basic idea was simple: create a transfer system that didn't depend on a single bank or authority.

emergencies.title: In which real situations can it help
emergencies.content: Not hypothetical scenarios, but situations that have already happened:
emergencies.keyPoint: In these cases the main problem is not value, but access and system continuity.

approach.title: What "emergency reserve" means
approach.content: Using cryptocurrencies as an emergency reserve does not mean replacing the traditional system.
approach.additionalContent: It means considering them as an additional option, to be evaluated only under certain conditions.
approach.keyPoint: The correct question is not: "How much do they yield?" But: "Under what conditions do they continue to work?"

purpose.title: Why this dashboard exists
purpose.content: This dashboard doesn't tell you what to buy.
items: understand when this approach is relevant
understand what its functioning depends on
avoid discovering its limits at the worst moment
purpose.keyPoint: The goal is to evaluate consciously, not to push you to invest.

cyber.title: Cyber risk (high probability future)
cyber.content: Financial institutions consider cyber attacks one of the main threats to operational continuity.
points: ENISA reports a constant increase in incidents in the financial sector
IMF and BIS recognize cyber-risk as a systemic stability risk
sources: IMF – Cyber Risk and Financial Stability
BIS – Operational and cyber risk in finance

systemic.title: Systemic risk
systemic.content: Financial systems are highly interconnected. A problem in a critical node can spread rapidly.

operational.title: Operational disruptions
operational.content: Even without financial crises, these can occur:
sources: World Economic Forum – Global Risks Report

conclusion.title: These scenarios:
points: are risks studied by those who manage the systems
conclusion.keyPoint: The dashboard serves to understand how they would affect you, not if they will happen.
